vertex_ai.label: Vertex AI (Gemini/Claude native)
vertex_ai.description: Vertex AI uses its own adapter key and is grouped with Gemini here; its adapter is not implemented in this release, and it does not take part in cross-protocol forwarding.

crossProtocol.title: Cross-protocol forwarding
crossProtocol.intro: Add the {header}: {values} header to POST /v1/chat/completions to choose which upstream protocol family the request must be routed to.
crossProtocol.selectionRules: The header only selects among channels that support the requested protocol family, and only for native adapters that are implemented (Vertex is not one). If no candidate supports it, or a pinned channel does not match, the request fails with 400. An empty header value is ignored.

status.on: On — requests that carry the header are forwarded to the selected upstream protocol.

crossProtocol.defaultOff: The switch defaults to off. While it is off, a request that carries x-newtg-protocol fails with 403 instead of being relayed.
crossProtocol.managedBy: The switch lives in site settings, which are not yet available in this release, so this console cannot read or change it.
crossProtocol.editableDeferred: An editable switch and protocol mapping will follow when site settings are available; no control is shown here until then.
